name: en_answer_conflict_multistep
description: Multi-step interview: an answer states a different minimum length than the requirement (10 vs 8), which must raise a conflict question; a vague clarification must raise a follow-up.
requirements:
REQ-1: The user enters a new password of at least 8 characters.
REQ-2: The password reset link is valid for 24 hours.
REQ-3: The reset page should be easy to use.

issues.note: a password that is too short
the answer says 10 characters, the requirement 8
what the user sees after setting the password

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-1.value: An error message is shown; the password must be at least 10 characters.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-1.value: The new password is saved and the user is signed in.

rule.ambiguous_wording.REQ-3.value: The page should be simple and clear.

answers_by_text.value: REQ-1: The user enters a new password of at least 8 characters.
